subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this native durable wake and replay subsystem in core once the lease-ownership defect is repaired?
rationale: The PR creates long-lived shared-state, runtime recovery, and delivery-adapter contracts whose permanent ownership and product scope cannot be decided by automated correctness review.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Accept the direction after replay ownership, upgrade proof, and the prerequisite foundation PR are approved.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Keep the stack open while maintainers narrow the core runtime and delivery-adapter contract.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Close the durable stack if native wake replay should not become an OpenClaw core responsibility.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the direction after replay ownership, upgrade proof, and the prerequisite foundation PR are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties this person to durable parent notices, subagent lifecycle ownership, shared state, and broader agent-runtime direction.
